correctness.rationale: At fixed \(N\), Bray–Curtis ordering is determined by \(\sum_i|x_i-y_i|\), while two-row correspondence-analysis squared chi-square ordering is determined by \(\sum_i (x_i-y_i)^2/(x_i+y_i)\). Exhaustive exact enumeration proves no inversion through \(N=9\) and verifies the \(N=10\) boundary and witness.

value.rationale: The two distances are standard ecological comparison tools with distinct weighting philosophies.
